group.name: Which Skyrim do you play on? (Skyrim Together 1.8.4)

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.7.104
plugin.description:
Skyrim Special/Anniversary Edition 1.7.104 with the Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.4 for 1.7.104 from Nexus (SKSE 2.3.x).
Installs the Skyrim Together launcher with the parkour add-on (SkyrimTogetherReborn/SkyrimTogether.exe). Mod Organizer 2 users: after installing, copy it into your Skyrim Together Reborn mod's SkyrimTogetherReborn folder (back up the original first); see the README.
